title: TOR 2018 — the route changes
claims: The organiser's 2018 announcement said the Tor des Géants route would be changed at two points.
In the municipality of Valgrisenche the base life moves from Bonne to Valgrisenche centre.
In the municipality of Torgnon the route changes between Finestra d'Ersaz and Rifugio Magià, affecting both Tor des Géants and Tot Dret.
